usedFor: Sellsy holds companies, contacts and invoices, MailerLite holds subscribers, and “Updated Contact” can feed “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Invoice Created” in Sellsy, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: A new invoice creates or updates a subscriber, so billing events can keep your list current.

watchOut: “Invoice Updated” fires on every edit, so “Create or Update Subscriber” can run repeatedly for the same invoice.
